values.note: $30 a night at the non-waterfront sites, $34 at the 86 waterfront (WF) sites; the same on a Saturday and from November 2026 through June 2027. One rate for everyone. $10 fee on any cancellation.

values.note: Bartow County's WebTrac reservation site or the campground office, 770-607-6245 (Mon-Fri 8-5, Sat 8-4). Senior/Access pass holders call the office to add the pass before booking. 14 nights in any 30 days at county campgrounds, then away 16 days. Check-in 3 pm; gate closed 10:30 pm - 7 am.

summary: WebTrac (still the engine) + county map and rules: 149 water/30-50 A sites, no sewer (stated), 20-60 ft (140 take 23 ft), 31 pull-throughs, 86 waterfront; $30 / $34 WF unchanged weekday/Saturday and Nov 2026 - Jun 2027 (stored 30-34 confirmed). Hookups, sites, showers/dump, senior-pass discount, weekend 2-night minimum and 14-night max added; booking.url to the McKinney search. Season: no county statement (WebTrac lists the sites with prices for Nov 2026 - Jun 2027 dates but its search view doesn't show availability), left unset. Lakefront supported: county map rings the peninsula with sites and WebTrac tags 86 WF. Pin is the gatehouse (matches the Corps GPS point N 34 06 42.7 W 84 41 48.8 and is ~105 m from Google's place); no per-site coordinates exist and the loops are under canopy, so no centroid check. Note unchanged (AWH line + the county line still true).
